tasks.title: Setup Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository for the Axum chat system upgrade.
tasks.details: Create a new Git repository for the project. Set up the initial directory structure, including folders for src, tests, and docs. Initialize a README.md file with project overview and setup instructions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository creation and structure by cloning it and checking the directory layout.

tasks.title: Create Database Models and Migrations
tasks.description: Define the data models and database migrations for the chat application.
tasks.details: Use SeaORM to define the data models for messages, users, and sessions. Create migration scripts to set up the SQLite/PostgreSQL database schema.
tasks.testStrategy: Run migrations and verify the database schema matches the defined models.

tasks.title: Implement Connection Manager
tasks.description: Develop a connection manager to handle user connections and disconnections.
tasks.details: Create a ConnectionManager struct that manages user connections using Arc<RwLock<T>> for thread safety. Implement methods for adding, removing, and notifying users of connection status changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate user connections and disconnections, and verify the connection manager updates the user list correctly.

tasks.title: Extend WebSocket Handler
tasks.description: Enhance the existing WebSocket handler to support chat functionalities.
tasks.details: Modify the existing task_controller.rs to add chat-related message handling. Implement methods for upgrading WebSocket connections and managing chat sessions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test WebSocket connections to ensure they can send and receive messages correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Message Distributor
tasks.description: Create a service to handle message broadcasting and distribution.
tasks.details: Develop a MessageDistributor service that uses tokio::sync::broadcast to send messages to all connected users. Ensure it can handle message queuing and backpressure.
tasks.testStrategy: Send test messages and verify that all connected clients receive them in real-time.

tasks.title: Develop User Notification Mechanism
tasks.description: Implement a system to notify users when others join or leave the chat.
tasks.details: Add functionality to the ConnectionManager to broadcast notifications to all users when someone joins or leaves the chat. Use the MessageDistributor for this purpose.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user join/leave scenarios and ensure notifications are sent to all users.

tasks.title: Implement Online User List Management
tasks.description: Create a system to maintain and display the list of online users.
tasks.details: Extend the ConnectionManager to maintain a list of online users. Implement a method to retrieve this list for display in the chat interface.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the online user list updates correctly as users connect and disconnect.

tasks.title: Integrate Message History Storage
tasks.description: Set up a system to store and query chat message history.
tasks.details: Use SeaORM to implement a MessageRepository for storing chat messages. Ensure it supports efficient retrieval and pagination of message history.
tasks.testStrategy: Test storing and retrieving messages to ensure they are correctly saved and can be queried.

tasks.title: Implement Message Search and Filtering
tasks.description: Add functionality to search and filter chat messages based on criteria.
tasks.details: Enhance the MessageRepository to support searching messages by keywords and filtering by date range. Implement pagination for results.
tasks.testStrategy: Test search and filtering functionality to ensure it returns the correct results.

tasks.title: Develop Real-time Status Synchronization
tasks.description: Implement a system to synchronize user and message statuses in real-time.
tasks.details: Create a status synchronization mechanism that updates user online status and message read/unread status using WebSocket messages.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate multiple users reading messages and verify that their statuses update in real-time for all clients.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Logging
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling and logging throughout the application.
tasks.details: Implement a centralized error handling strategy and logging mechanism using a logging library. Ensure all errors are logged appropriately.
tasks.testStrategy: Trigger various errors during testing and verify that they are logged correctly.

subtasks.title: 增强错误处理中间件
subtasks.description: 基于Axum 0.8.4 HandleErrorLayer实现全局错误处理中间件，包括超时处理、请求验证错误和自定义错误映射
subtasks.details: 实现HandleErrorLayer中间件来捕获和处理各种错误类型，确保所有错误都能正确转换为HTTP响应

subtasks.title: 实现结构化日志记录
subtasks.description: 使用tracing-subscriber配置结构化日志，支持JSON格式输出、字段过滤和多层级日志记录
subtasks.details: 配置tracing-subscriber支持JSON格式、时间戳、请求ID跟踪和环境变量控制的日志级别

subtasks.title: 添加错误跟踪和上下文
subtasks.description: 集成tracing-error库实现SpanTrace错误上下文跟踪，提供详细的错误调用链信息
subtasks.details: 使用tracing-error的SpanTrace和ErrorSubscriber来捕获错误发生时的span上下文

subtasks.title: 实现日志文件轮转和管理
subtasks.description: 使用tracing-appender实现日志文件的自动轮转、归档和清理机制
subtasks.details: 配置按时间或大小轮转的日志文件，支持压缩归档和自动清理旧日志

subtasks.title: 添加性能监控和指标日志
subtasks.description: 实现请求延迟、吞吐量、内存使用等性能指标的监控和日志记录
subtasks.details: 使用tracing的instrument宏和自定义指标收集器来监控关键性能指标

subtasks.title: 实现安全审计日志
subtasks.description: 添加安全相关事件的审计日志，包括认证失败、权限检查、敏感操作等
subtasks.details: 创建专门的安全审计日志记录器，记录所有安全相关的事件和操作

subtasks.title: 实现错误恢复机制
subtasks.description: 添加自动错误恢复、重试逻辑和降级处理机制
subtasks.details: 实现指数退避重试、断路器模式和优雅降级来处理临时性错误

subtasks.title: 添加全面的测试覆盖
subtasks.description: 为错误处理和日志记录功能编写单元测试和集成测试
subtasks.details: 使用tracing-test和mockall创建测试，验证错误处理、日志记录和恢复机制的正确性

tasks.title: Set Up Monitoring and Health Checks
tasks.description: Implement monitoring and health check endpoints for the chat system.
tasks.details: Create health check endpoints that return the status of the chat system. Integrate monitoring tools to track performance metrics.
tasks.testStrategy: Access health check endpoints and verify they return the correct status information.

subtasks.title: 增强基础健康检查端点
subtasks.description: 扩展现有的 /api/performance/health 端点，添加更多系统组件检查，包括磁盘空间、系统负载、错误恢复状态等。实现快速响应的基础健康检查，适用于负载均衡器。
subtasks.details: 1. 添加磁盘空间检查 2. 添加系统负载检查 3. 集成错误恢复状态检查 4. 优化响应时间 5. 编写单元测试

subtasks.title: 实现Prometheus指标导出端点
subtasks.description: 创建 /metrics 端点，导出Prometheus格式的指标数据，包括HTTP请求指标、系统资源指标、WebSocket连接指标等。集成metrics-exporter-prometheus库。
subtasks.details: 1. 配置Prometheus导出器 2. 创建/metrics端点 3. 导出HTTP指标 4. 导出系统资源指标 5. 导出WebSocket指标 6. 编写集成测试

subtasks.title: 添加应用就绪状态检查（Readiness Probe）
subtasks.description: 实现 /api/health/ready 端点，检查应用是否准备好接收流量。包括数据库迁移状态、依赖服务连接、配置加载状态等深度检查。
subtasks.details: 1. 创建readiness检查端点 2. 检查数据库迁移状态 3. 检查依赖服务连接 4. 检查配置完整性 5. 实现超时机制 6. 编写单元测试

subtasks.title: 实现存活状态检查（Liveness Probe）
subtasks.description: 实现 /api/health/live 端点，检查应用进程是否存活且响应正常。包括内存泄漏检测、死锁检测、响应时间检查等。
subtasks.details: 1. 创建liveness检查端点 2. 实现内存使用检查 3. 添加响应时间监控 4. 检查关键线程状态 5. 实现快速响应机制 6. 编写单元测试

subtasks.title: 添加深度健康检查端点
subtasks.description: 实现 /api/health/deep 端点，提供详细的系统诊断信息，包括所有组件状态、性能指标、错误统计、资源使用详情等。适用于运维人员深度诊断。
subtasks.details: 1. 创建深度检查端点 2. 集成所有组件状态 3. 添加性能基准对比 4. 实现诊断报告生成 5. 添加历史趋势分析 6. 编写集成测试

subtasks.title: 实现监控中间件增强
subtasks.description: 增强现有的性能监控中间件，添加更多HTTP请求指标收集，包括请求大小、响应大小、用户代理统计、地理位置统计等企业级监控功能。
subtasks.details: 1. 扩展请求指标收集 2. 添加响应大小监控 3. 实现用户代理统计 4. 添加错误分类统计 5. 优化性能开销 6. 编写性能测试

subtasks.title: 添加WebSocket连接监控和统计
subtasks.description: 实现专门的WebSocket监控端点 /api/websocket/stats，提供WebSocket连接统计、消息吞吐量、连接持续时间、断线重连统计等聊天应用关键指标。
subtasks.details: 1. 创建WebSocket统计端点 2. 监控连接生命周期 3. 统计消息吞吐量 4. 追踪断线重连 5. 实现实时统计更新 6. 编写WebSocket测试

subtasks.title: 实现系统资源监控和告警阈值检查
subtasks.description: 实现 /api/monitoring/alerts 端点，提供系统资源告警检查，包括CPU使用率、内存使用率、磁盘空间、网络连接数等阈值监控和告警状态。
subtasks.details: 1. 创建告警检查端点 2. 配置资源阈值 3. 实现告警状态管理 4. 添加告警历史记录 5. 实现告警级别分类 6. 编写告警测试

tasks.title: Conduct Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Optimize the application for performance and memory management.
tasks.details: Analyze performance bottlenecks and implement optimizations such as connection pooling, message batching, and zero-copy techniques.
tasks.testStrategy: Run performance tests to measure improvements in response times and resource usage.

subtasks.title: 消息批处理优化
subtasks.description: 实施零拷贝消息传递、动态批处理大小调整和消息压缩，优化MessageDistributor性能。目标：提升消息吞吐量40-60%，支持百万并发连接的消息分发。
subtasks.details: 1. 使用Bytes替代Vec<u8>实现零拷贝 2. 实施动态批处理大小算法 3. 添加消息压缩支持 4. 优化消息优先级调度 5. 添加批处理性能监控指标 6. 编写完整的单元测试和集成测试

subtasks.title: 异步性能优化
subtasks.description: 优化Tokio任务调度、I/O多路复用和背压处理机制。目标：提升异步处理效率30-40%，优化P99延迟至<50ms。
subtasks.details: 1. 优化Tokio任务调度策略 2. 实施高效的I/O多路复用 3. 添加背压处理机制 4. 优化异步任务生命周期管理 5. 实施任务优先级调度 6. 添加异步性能监控和测试

subtasks.title: 内存管理优化
subtasks.description: 减少状态克隆操作、实施智能缓存策略和内存池管理。目标：降低内存使用20-30%，提升缓存命中率至>90%。
subtasks.details: 1. 减少Axum状态克隆操作 2. 实施L1内存缓存策略 3. 添加对象池和内存池 4. 优化数据结构内存布局 5. 实施智能缓存淘汰算法 6. 添加内存使用监控和泄漏检测

subtasks.title: 连接池优化
subtasks.description: 优化数据库连接池和WebSocket连接池配置，实施TCP_NODELAY和连接保活机制。目标：提升连接处理效率30-50%，支持百万并发连接。
subtasks.details: 1. 优化SeaORM数据库连接池配置 2. 实施WebSocket连接池和复用 3. 启用TCP_NODELAY和连接保活 4. 优化连接生命周期管理 5. 添加连接池监控指标 6. 实施连接负载均衡和故障转移
